description: Revert to the empirically proven "Gold Standard" configuration (Depth=8, Matrix LR=0.06, WD=0.1, Batch=128) which has consistently yielded the best val_bpb (~0.9904-0.9905) and stable convergence, as recent aggressive (0.07 LR) and conservative (0.055 LR) attempts degraded performance or caused instability.
